policy_title: Ratify Global Oceans Treaty and Continue Deep Sea Mining Moratorium
stated: The Conservative Party will ratify the Global Oceans Treaty early in the next Parliament and continue with its moratorium on deep sea mining.

source.quote: We will continue with our moratorium on deep sea mining and will ratify the Global Oceans Treaty early in the next Parliament.

bearing_set.reason: The Global Oceans Treaty (BBNJ Agreement) creates binding protections for marine biodiversity on the high seas, and the deep sea mining moratorium directly prevents ecosystem disruption on the ocean floor — both bear materially on water/ocean quality, nature, and the clean-environment fundamental.

membership_note: The policy is narrowly and specifically an environmental/nature protection measure. Any effect on O13 (foregone critical-mineral extraction) is indirect for the UK — the UK has no active deep sea mining operations and alternative land-based supply chains exist — placing it below the non-negligible threshold. No other fundamental is plausibly moved by this policy at a material level.
